<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

Project-specific instructions and guidelines:

<project_instructions path="/home/box/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md">
# 全局约定

Chasen | AI-native Builder | 默认简体中文。项目规则优先。

## 沟通
- 结论先行，简短直接；不编造事实，明确假设与不确定性。
- 先从代码和现有约定查证；只有缺失信息会实质影响目标、范围、正确性或授权时才澄清。
- 完成后说明改了什么、验证了什么及残余风险；未完成时给出具体阻碍和下一步。

## 编码
- 一次聚焦一个明确目标，只改必要部分，保持现有风格，不顺手重构。
- 修改前理解相关实现、调用方和测试；修复根因，不只修补症状。
- 优先复用现有实现、标准库和已有依赖，不添加推测性功能或不必要的抽象。
- 简化不能牺牲正确性、安全、可访问性或防止数据丢失的错误处理。
- 非平凡行为变化尽量补充最小回归测试；修改后运行最相关的检查，再审阅最终 diff。
- 检查失败要诊断，不掩盖；没有验证证据，不声称已验证完成。

## 工具与上下文
- 定位用 find/grep；已知文件用 read 定向读取，保留理解逻辑所需的上下文。Shell 搜索用 rg。
- 需要联网查资料或读网页时用 `web_search` / `web_fetch`（Tavily），不要编造链接或页面内容。
- 大输出只保留相关结论和关键证据；小文件直接读，不绕行。
- 当前代码与配置以工作区为准，历史记忆只作线索；文档按需索引，不默认复制整个仓库。
- 默认直接执行；仅在独立工作或上下文隔离确有收益时委派，避免多个写入者竞争同一工作区。


## 杂活执行
- 本机 Pi 面向其他 Bot 派来的批量改文件、整理数据、读仓库写总结、长文本处理等杂活；默认用 OpenRouter 免费模型，不擅自改成付费模型。
- 无人值守调用：`pi -p '...' </dev/null`；需要联网搜索或抓网页时先加载 `~/.pi/agent/secrets.env`（或走 `~/.pi/agent/with-env.sh pi ...`），再用 `web_search` / `web_fetch`（Tavily）。
- 只做委托范围内的事：改必要文件、给出可核对的结果；不做 UI 美化、不顺手重构、不主动改 Pi 默认模型或付费路由。
- 完成后用简洁中文交代：改了什么、怎么验证、残留风险或阻塞。

## 边界
- 未经授权，不提交、推送、删除或公开内容。

</project_instructions>
</project_context>

    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 80;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 84%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  }
  .top-inner {
    width: min(1280px, calc(100% - var(--pad) * 2));
    margin-inline: auto;
    height: 68px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px;
  }
  .brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .brand-mark {
    width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--card);
    font-family: var(--display); font-size: 22px; line-height: 1;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--cyan);
    transition: transform .2s var(--ease), box-shadow .2s var(--ease);
  }
  .brand:hover .brand-mark { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--cyan); }
  .brand-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .01em; }
  .brand-name span { display: block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .16em; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; }

  .nav { display: flex; gap: 26px; margin-left: auto; }
  .nav a {
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em;
    color: var(--muted); display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px;
    padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: color .18s, border-color .18s;
  }
  .nav a sup { font-size: 8px; color: var(--cyan); letter-spacing: 0; }
  .nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); }

  .top-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
  .status {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--muted);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .status i {
    width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--cyan-soft); animation: pulse 2.6s infinite;
  }
  .theme-toggle {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: transparent;
    padding: 7px 10px; cursor: pointer; min-width: 72px; justify-content: center;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .06em;
    transition: background .18s, border-color .18s;
  }
  .theme-toggle:hover { background: var(--card); border-color: var(--ink); }
  .theme-icon { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; color: var(--cyan); }

  @keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--cyan-soft); }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px transparent; }
  }

  /* ---------- hero ---------- */
  .hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .hero::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 64px 64px;
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 32% 8%, #000 10%, transparent 72%);
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 32% 8%, #000 10%, transparent 72%);
  }
  .hero-inner {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    padding: clamp(44px, 7vw, 92px) 0 clamp(38px, 5vw, 64px);
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.28fr) minmax(280px, .72fr);
    gap: clamp(30px, 5vw, 64px); align-items: center;
  }
  .eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .13em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .eyebrow .dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--cyan); border-radius: 50%; }
  .eyebrow .sep { color: var(--line-strong); }
  .eyebrow strong { font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); }

  .display {
    font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 400;
    font-size: clamp(72px, 13.2vw, 172px); line-height: .84;
    letter-spacing: -.035em; margin: 22px 0 14px;
  }
  .display .dot { color: var(--pink); }
  .name-sub {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .22em;
    color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 26px;
  }
  .name-sub::after { content: ""; height: 1px; width: 64px; background: var(--line-strong); }

  .hero-cn {
    font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(15px, 1.8vw, 18px); font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--body); letter-spacing: .01em;
  }
  .hero-cn em {
    font-family: var(--display); font-style: italic; font-size: 1.24em;
    color: var(--ink); padding-bottom: 1px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--pink);
  }
  .hero-lede {
    margin-top: 22px; max-width: 31em;
    font-size: clamp(17px, 2.1vw, 22px); line-height: 1.72; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .hero-lede strong {
    font-weight: 600;
    background: linear-gradient(transparent 60%, var(--mark) 60%);
    padding: 0 2px;
  }

  .cta-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-top: 34px; }
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); padding: 13px 18px;
    font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2;
    transition: transform .18s var(--ease), box-shadow .18s var(--ease), background .18s;
  }
  .btn .tag {
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .06em;
    border: 1px solid currentColor; padding: 2px 5px; opacity: .6; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--ink); color: var(--ink-contrast);
    box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--pink);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--pink); }
  .btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--pink); }
  .btn-ghost { background: transparent; border-color: var(--line-strong); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--card); border-color: var(--ink); }
  .cta-note {
    flex-basis: 100%; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .hero-figure { justify-self: end; width: 100%; max-width: 372px; position: relative; }
  .photo-card {
    position: relative; transform: rotate(2deg);
    background: var(--card); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
    padding: 12px 12px 0;
    box-shadow: 11px 11px 0 var(--cyan-soft);
    transition: transform .3s var(--ease), box-shadow .3s var(--ease);
  }
  .photo-card:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 13px 15px 0 var(--cyan-soft); }
  .photo-card img {
    width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; object-fit: cover;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper);
  }
  .tape {
    position: absolute; top: -13px; left: 50%; width: 96px; height: 26px;
    transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-4deg);
    background: rgba(232, 134, 166, .5);
    border: 1px solid rgba(232, 134, 166, .65);
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
  }
  .photo-card figcaption {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 2px 12px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .fig-note {
    margin-top: 24px; padding-left: 2px;
    display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: flex-start;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9.5px; line-height: 1.7;
    letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .fig-note::before { content: "↳"; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; }

  .side-note {
    position: absolute; right: 14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .36em;
    color: var(--muted); opacity: .7;
  }

  .meta-strip {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .meta-cell { padding: 20px 22px 22px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .meta-cell:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
  .meta-cell:last-child { border-right: 0; }
  .meta-cell .k {
    display: block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .14em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .meta-cell .v { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .01em; }
  .meta-cell .v span { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; }

  /* ---------- ticker ---------- */
  .ticker {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
    background: var(--cyan); color: #0c2a31; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .ticker-track {
    display: flex; width: max-content;
    animation: marquee 36s linear infinite;
  }
  .ticker:hover .ticker-track { animation-play-state: paused; }
  .ticker-group { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 11px 0; }
  .ticker-group span {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px;
    padding-right: 18px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ticker-group span::after { content: "✦"; font-size: 9px; opacity: .65; }
  @keyframes marquee { to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

  /* ---------- sections ---------- */
  .section { padding-top: clamp(72px, 9.5vw, 132px); }
  .sec-head {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
    padding-top: 13px; margin-bottom: clamp(34px, 5vw, 56px);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .sec-num { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--cyan); }
  .sec-label {
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .2em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .sec-line { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--line); }
  .sec-aside {
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .08em;
    color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600;
    font-size: clamp(32px, 4.6vw, 56px); line-height: 1.34;
    letter-spacing: -.01em;
  }
  .h2 .u {
    text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--pink);
    text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-underline-offset: 9px;
  }
  .h2 .light { color: var(--muted); }

  /* ---------- about ---------- */
  .about-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .82fr) minmax(0, 1.18fr);
    gap: clamp(34px, 6vw, 88px); align-items: start;
  }
  .about-left { position: sticky; top: 104px; }
  .about-left .h2 { max-width: 8em; }
  .about-id { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-top: 36px; }
  .about-id img {
    width: 62px; height: 62px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
    border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--card);
  }
  .about-id b { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .01em; }
  .about-id span {
    display: block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 2px;
  }
  .prose { max-width: 40em; }
  .prose p { color: var(--body); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.92; margin-bottom: 1.25em; }
  .prose p:first-child { font-size: 18.5px; line-height: 1.82; color: var(--ink); }
  .prose p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .prose .hl { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
  .prose blockquote {
    margin: 30px 0 30px; padding: 4px 0 4px 22px;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--cyan);
    font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(19px, 2.4vw, 24px);
    line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .prose blockquote span {
    display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--muted);
  }

  /* ---------- work ---------- */
  .work-intro {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline; gap: 12px 28px; margin-bottom: 30px;
  }
  .work-intro .h2 { max-width: 12em; }
  .work-intro p { max-width: 26em; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.85; }
  .work-intro p b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }

  .flag {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(0, .95fr);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--card);
    box-shadow: 9px 9px 0 var(--cyan-soft);
  }
  .flag-main { padding: clamp(24px, 3.6vw, 42px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
  .flag-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .badge {
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase;
    border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 4px 7px; background: var(--pink-soft);
  }
  .flag-stars { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--muted); }
  .flag-stars b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
  .flag h3 {
    font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 500;
    font-size: clamp(21px, 2.7vw, 29px); letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1.3;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .flag h3 a { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--pink); transition: color .18s, border-color .18s; }
  .flag h3 a:hover { color: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--cyan); }
  .flag-desc { margin-top: 16px; color: var(--body); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.85; max-width: 34em; }
  .feat {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 7px 18px;
    margin: 24px 0 26px; width: 100%;
  }
  .feat li {
    display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline;
    font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--body);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 7px;
  }
  .feat li::before { content: "+"; font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--cyan); }
  .stack-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
  .stack-row span {
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .04em;
    padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); color: var(--muted);
  }
  .repo-link {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: auto;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .03em;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); padding-bottom: 3px;
    transition: color .18s, border-color .18s, gap .18s;
  }
  .repo-link:hover { color: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--cyan); gap: 12px; }

  .flag-visual {
    position: relative; border-left: 1px solid var(--ink);
    background:
      linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 7%, var(--paper));
    background-size: 28px 28px, 28px 28px, auto;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 34px);
  }
  .mock {
    width: 100%; max-width: 470px;
    background: #12171a; color: #cfd8dc;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .14);
    box-shadow: 0 26px 50px -26px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .mock-bar {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    height: 30px; padding: 0 10px;
    background: #1d2327; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  }
  .mock-bar i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f2a3bd; }
  .mock-bar i:nth-child(2) { background: #f0d19a; }
  .mock-bar i:nth-child(3) { background: #6fdcef; }
  .mock-title { margin-left: auto; color: #8fa0a8; letter-spacing: .04em; }
  .mock-branch { margin-left: auto; color: #6fdcef; font-size: 9px; }
  .mock-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36% 64%; min-height: 246px; }
  .mock-side { background: #141a1e; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .07); padding: 10px 0; }
  .mock-side .label {
    font-size: 7.5px; letter-spacing: .16em; color: #6f818a;
    padding: 0 12px 7px;
  }
  .mock-side .item {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 9px; color: #98a8b0;
    white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .mock-side .item.on { background: rgba(111, 220, 239, .1); color: #dff7fb; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #6fdcef; }
  .mock-side .item .b { color: #6fdcef; font-size: 9px; }
  .mock-side .new { margin-top: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; color: #6f818a; font-size: 9px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .06); }
  .mock-chat { padding: 10px 12px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .mock-chip {
    align-self: flex-start; font-size: 8px; color: #f2a3bd;
    border: 1px solid rgba(242, 163, 189, .35); padding: 2px 6px; margin-bottom: 9px;
  }
  .mock-msg { font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.65; padding: 7px 9px; margin-bottom: 7px; max-width: 92%; }
  .mock-msg.user { align-self: flex-end; background: rgba(242, 163, 189, .12); border: 1px solid rgba(242, 163, 189, .18); color: #e8d9df; }
  .mock-msg.ai { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .045); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); color: #b9c6cc; }
  .mock-msg.ai b { color: #6fdcef; font-weight: 500; }
  .caret {
    display: inline-block; width: 5px; height: 9px; margin-left: 2px;
    background: #6fdcef; vertical-align: -1px; animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
  .mock-input {
    margin-top: auto; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    padding: 8px 0; font-size: 8.5px; color: #7f9199;
  }
  .mock-input .send { color: #6fdcef; border: 1px solid rgba(111, 220, 239, .3); padding: 1px 5px; }
  .mock-caption {
    margin-top: 16px; text-align: center;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8.5px; letter-spacing: .1em;
    color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .proj-list { margin-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .proj {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0, 1fr) 38px;
    gap: 8px 18px; align-items: center;
    padding: 24px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    transition: background .2s var(--ease), padding-left .2s var(--ease), box-shadow .2s;
  }
  .proj:hover {
    background: var(--card); padding-left: 18px;
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--cyan);
  }
  .proj .num { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); align-self: start; padding-top: 7px; }
  .proj h3 { font-size: clamp(19px, 2.2vw, 23px); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.015em; line-height: 1.4; transition: color .18s; }
  .proj:hover h3 { color: var(--cyan); }
  .proj p { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--muted); max-width: 46em; }
  .proj-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 14px; margin-top: 10px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--muted); }
  .proj-meta .stars { color: var(--ink); }
  .proj-meta .stars::before { content: "★"; color: var(--cyan); margin-right: 4px; }
  .proj-meta .kind { border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 1px 6px; }
  .proj-arrow {
    width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 50%;
    font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted);
    transition: background .18s, color .18s, border-color .18s, transform .18s;
  }
  .proj:hover .proj-arrow { background: var(--ink); color: var(--ink-contrast); border-color: var(--ink); transform: rotate(45deg); }
  .work-note {
    margin-top: 18px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .todo-chip {
    display: inline-block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8.5px;
    letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--muted);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); padding: 2px 6px; white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* ---------- stack ---------- */
  .stack-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(24px, 4vw, 54px);
  }
  .stack-col { border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); padding-top: 16px; }
  .stack-col h3 {
    display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .stack-col h3 span { color: var(--cyan); letter-spacing: .04em; }
  .stack-list { margin-top: 14px; }
